def tokenize_code(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Keep whole identifiers while also exposing snake/camel-case components."""
    tokens = []
    for match in IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.finditer(text):
        identifier = match.group().lower()
        tokens.append(identifier)
        parts = IDENTIFIER_PART_PATTERN.findall(match.group())
        tokens.extend(part.lower() for part in parts if part.lower() != identifier)
    return tokens


def feature_counts(text: str, dimensions: int) -> Counter[int]:
    tokens = tokenize_code(text)
    features = Counter(f"token:{token}" for token in tokens)
    features.update(
        f"bigram:{left} {right}" for left, right in zip(tokens, tokens[1:])
    )
    counts: Counter[int] = Counter()
    for feature, count in features.items():
        digest = hashlib.blake2b(
            feature.encode("utf-8"), digest_size=8, person=b"ai4se-rag"
        ).digest()
        counts[int.from_bytes(digest, "big") % dimensions] += count
    return counts

class AuditTrail:
    """Class-based decorator recording call outcomes into an in-memory list.

    When applied it wraps a callable so that, after each invocation, an entry
    such as ``"<label>:<func_name>:ok"`` (or ``:error:<ExcName>`` on failure)
    is appended to an internal list. Entries are retrievable via
    :attr:`entries` and the trail can be reset with :meth:`clear`.
    """

    def __init__(self, label: str = "audit") -> None:
        """Initialise the trail with a non-empty string ``label``."""
        if not isinstance(label, str):
            raise TypeError("label must be str")
        if label.strip() == "":
            raise ValueError("label required")
        self._label = label
        self._entries: List[str] = []

    def __call__(self, func: Callable[..., T]) -> Callable[..., T]:
        """Decorate ``func``; returns a wrapped callable."""
        if not callable(func):
            raise TypeError("func must be callable")
        label = self._label
        entries = self._entries
